ingredients: 150;G;White chocolate;; | 60;ML;Milk;; | 30;G;Condensed milk;g(adds shine); | 1;TBSP;Water;tbsp (to dissolve cornstarch); | 10;G;Butter;g (for smoothness, optional);
steps: Melt white chocolate gently — don’t overheat. | Warm milk + condensed milk together (no boiling). | Mix 1 tsp cornstarch + 1 tbsp water, add to the warm milk, and cook on low until it lightly thickens. | Pour this into the melted chocolate and stir until smooth + glossy. | Let the glaze cool to 30–32°C — this is the perfect pouring temperature. | Divide, colour lightly, and swirl without fully mixing to create the marble effect. | Pour over a very cold cake for best shine and smooth flow
